title: Um dia na loja
grammar: In the morning, in the afternoon, at night e at noon
goal: Use in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening e at noon, at night para situar a hora.
reading: Tina works in a small shop.
She opens the door in the morning.
Ela abre a porta de manhã.
In the afternoon many people come.
dialogue: At noon. I am very hungry then.
Ao meio-dia. Estou com muita fome.
Do you work in the afternoon?
What do you do in the evening?
O que você faz à noite?
I cook dinner and watch TV.
Faço o jantar e vejo TV.
Do you sleep well at night?
pron: O acento fica na última sílaba: af-ter-NOON.
